summary:
Amazing writing. It is the kind of writing that drills down into the deepest parts of your soul to strip you bare and then price you back together. Amazing story telling. Amazing characters and development. Raw, emotional and breathtakingly beautiful. So much angst, fear, desire, soul healing enduring kind of love. There is so much darkness in this story but the HEA (in b2 and b2.6) is the brightest all consuming beautiful perfection. All the darkness comes from the past - not the main characters.

I have read the book before- the audio is amazing. The acting is perfect. No overacting but just the right level of emotions when really needed as to not fatigue the listener by the non stop tension and passion. You can tell the actors really understand and feel the characters emotions.

Jessie Walker easily took the top spot in my favorite author list with this series. Absolutely brilliant author!
title: As beautiful as it is devastating

summary: This book is the worst. This is a perfect example of an author trying too hard to out dark all other dr. But it is just isn't good, There are plenty of books have monsters and plenty of mafia type books have beyond ruthless characters but this one is just terrible. I love a good pitch black romance but this one is nothing more than taking every character type or trope to the max without anything likeable. The FMC goes from victim to wanting all the dick falling in love with all the mmcs in a few days. She unjustifiably and stupidly stubborn and defiant in the most annoying ways. She doesn't come off as strong just stupid. She holds onto anger at the wrong people for the dumbest reasons - the main one being the author has no idea how to write tension and conflict so they make her dumb and obstinate instead. She is treated terribly by all the male character both enemies and lovers. All the MCs fall in love with her at first sight and totally go gaga and stupid over instantly without any justifiable or believable reason. Every word is the author just trying to push limits of how gross they can make the characters and none of hits.
title: terrible

summary: Be prepared to laugh out loud. The cupidity books have the most lovable and hilarious FMCs. Trix is just as adorable as ML from heart hassle series. The writing is just so darn witty without being cheesy or cringy. I can’t get enough of the absurdity and cuteness. But the romance… such an absolutely perfect MMC. Such a heart happy fun listen!!!
title: So fun and swoon worthy

summary:
This books is so repetitive. Even if wasn’t the 6th in series to be read in order there is no reason to reiterate how poorly women are treated or their role as mindless whores over and over in every chapter. There is also no real reason given for all of the horrible things the leaders do or make others do. Yeah yeah… power and money. But this one in particular the acts are all way more grotesque and brutal yet far more removed from any reasonable reason. The constant sharing of the clip of Hayden telling his wife how much he loves her is sweet but not enough to make up for the rest of the garbage.

I think the only reason this book is as popular as it is - is because it is read by Corvin King. He could read me a dictionary and I would be happy.
title: Horrible

summary: Story had potential but I am not buying anything they characters say or do- it is all just terrible acting in a high school production of a mafia soap opera. The author made a check list of popular catch phrases, spicy scenes, tropes and character types and randomly selected items from each category and dropped them on the page even if they didn’t make sense or flow. Like a copy and paste from 100 other better writer books with the words scrambles a little and is obvious imposter.
title: Nothing but cliche catch phrases and scenes

summary:
I read this a while ago and it was so good I wanted to read again. There are few books that pack as much raw intensity as this one does right from chapter 1. The narration elevates it to the next level. Of course Joe Arden is incredible as ever but it is Devin Ryder as Tristan that makes this book to a whole new level. Ryders acting is incredible. I feel every single emotion: fury, insecurity, hurt, lust, frustrating, desire, confusion as if they were my own. It doesn’t sound like acting- it is as if he truly is Tristan reacting to everything that is happening.

The story is beautiful. The rawness of the emotions is incredible. It is concise yet the character depth achieved so quickly is nothing short of brilliant. I understood and fell in love with Tristan within a few paragraphs- sure there is/was plenty more to uncover but I was completely invested in his goals and satisfaction, relief, happiness… I wanted it all for him by the end of the first chapter. And watching the effect he has on Dante is delightfully consuming.
title: Absolute perfection writing and narration

summary: Sierra Simone is the queen of longing and desire, sensual and scorching spice. The new narration is absolute top notch next level perfection. This is my favorite spicy series!!
title: So hot! So captivating!

summary: So good. Haven’t cried this hard from any book, movie, tv show. It is the kind of book that will stay with me for a very long time. Audio is perfection that easily elevates the book 10x. If I could I would give this book 6-7 stars just for being so blindsided by emotions.
title: Absolutely wrecked me

summary:
This book feels like it skipped any kind of editing. There are so many repetitive chapters. Kind of like when you have long series and each book repeats some of the important details for the previous books in the first couple chapters… except this book is repeating the same details every few chapters. It also slips from first person to third person a few times mid paragraph.

There is very little spice for having 5 guys. The spice is poorly written. There is maybe one short scene that was hot but the rest were almost as if the author was glossing over what happened- almost matter of facts.

The female narrator was ok for delivering snarky comments and whatever the characters were saying out loud but for everything else it was very matter of fact with annoying repetitive cadence and inflections.
title: Repetitive and no spice

summary: This series has taken top spot for me. From the first scene in book 1 to where is ended is such a surprise. This series has one of the most satisfying conclusions. The character growth and strength is inspiring. I wouldn’t change a thing about the MMC and MFC or their journey. The minor supporting characters are also amazing. The worlds are beautifully build. The VA / narration is next level. Lilly Drake and Anthony Palmini are some of the best out there for sure. They really take this series to the next level with the heart and soul they put into their work.
title: BEST MMC and MFC ever
